notes.title: Match Point! Serving new languages, bug fixes and 20% discount!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34738013/6385450c368c5f52b6afa8bb413f28a8e49064f6.png[/img]

Well, hello there! We hope everyone is having a great summer!

First of all, we would like to start this announcement saying that we are very thankful for everyone who has offered us feedback, suggestions and bug reports for Super Tennis Blast.

We're back with a couple of news that surely you'll love:

First, there is a [b]new update[/b] which contains [b]performance bug fixes and also new languages[/b]! Super Tennis Blast becomes more international and now the language can't stop you to win a Grand Slam:
[list]
[*] added languages: French, Italian, German, Russian, Chinese (simplified), Portuguese (Brazil), Catalan
[*] fixed the performance problems affecting doubles matches
[/list]
Secondly, Super Tennis Blast hits weeklong deals with a [b]20% discount[/b]. Now, you can dust off your racket and smash your friends on the court for a few bucks.

Finally, we've started to work on [b]our next Super Blast title[/b], do you have any guesses about which sport will it be based on?

If you want to know more, stay tuned on social media for more announcements on this! :)

Keep the good mood UP!

notes.title: Become a tennis ace with the new update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34738013/1062c60b795f8094ec495cbc37668d7b3290caa9.jpg[/img]

Hey! How is it going? How’s the heat in your side?

After the release of Super Tennis Blast, we’ve been taking into account all your feedback while we start preparing for the next upcoming title of the Super Blast series ;)

Although, we’re not going to lie to you, we spared some time to check the Roland Garros (As Spaniards, we’re so proud of Nadal!) and now we’re eager for the upcoming Wimbledon.

To warm up before this Grand Slam, and as we promised, we have released today an update with cool new content: 
[list]
[*] added several new Super Blast modes plus a new music theme
[*] added caps and bands for the avatars
[*] added caricatures of famous characters
[*] added special dressing for the UK Grand Blast
[*] added option to play always at the bottom
[/list]
Also, we’ve worked to improve some stuff: 
[list]
[*] Animations and some graphic stuff
[*] Tweaked gameplay
[*] AI in doubles
[/list]
Check it out and leave us your thought on the comments sections below! We’re looking forward to your feedback on this!

notes.title: Oi! Como vai? New update with cool features and fixes!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34738013/8c9feb4e7974572b505bc5438bf7cfa175cbb4fe.jpg[/img]

Hi there!! How is it going? Have you been training your shots?

From our side, after the update released a few days ago, we still keep working to improve the game and add new features to Super Tennis Blast.
[list]
[*] Don't feel like playing on top? Now, you can always play on the bottom option (available in options menu)
[*] Oi! Como vai? Added Portuguese (Brazil), more languages to come very soon!
[*] Proud of your tennis character? Want to see a new angle? Now, you can rotate your avatar using right stick in the avatar editor
[/list]
More fixes:
[list]
[*] fixed some color issues in editor (with random colors and current color)
[*] fixed bug in the character overwrite pop-up
[*] fixed renaming character with keyboard bug
[/list]
Hope this update improves the overall tennis experience! Don't hesitate to comment if you have more feedback or show that you're enjoying the game (Specially the last thing make us very happy :D)

notes.title: Game, set, update! Minor bugs and improvements!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34738013/91116277cadbb07adc46529e4ea871be00addc64.png[/img]

Hi Tennis fans! How is it going? Are you a tennis legend already?

Hope you've been enjoying the game these couple of weeks. After the release, we've kept working to improve Super Tennis Blast and fixed some bugs notified by you (thanks btw!)

Today, we've released a new update to fix those bugs that will result in a better experience playing on the tennis courts. Here is the list:
[list]
[*] fixed bug that made to copy the last selected difficulty over World Tour matches
[*] fixing two achievements that were impossible to unlock
[*] now mouse pointer is not locked in the center of the screen
[*] fixed NO button in the QUIT pop-up
[/list]
But that's not all! We're still working on new exciting Super Blast modes and on a few more surprises that we will add very soon, so stay tuned!
